title: NBIM urges SEC to reform shareholder proposal rule, not rescind it
lede: Sovereign wealth fund suggests regulator should consider amendments while preserving 'uniform, predictable route' to ballot.

title: [Interview] ‘There is nothing soft about Russian soft power’: Ukraine institute director on the battle to re-name streets honouring Pushkin and other Russian figures
lede: Should Russian cultural figures continue to be celebrated in European public spaces? Should streets named after Pushkin be renamed? Where do we draw the line between rejecting Russian imperialism and preserving Russian cultural heritage? These are some of the questions director general of the Ukrainian Institute Volodymyr Sheiko discusses with EUobserver.
